## 10. Ready checklist

- [ ] Objective and CTA confirmed
- [ ] Audience and channel confirmed
- [ ] Duration and format confirmed
- [ ] Script or required message complete
- [ ] Required source assets uploaded
- [ ] Rights and legal owner confirmed
- [ ] Brand rules linked
- [ ] Final approver named
- [ ] AI / confidentiality restrictions recorded
- [ ] Desired timing recorded

The Producer marks the request Ready only after all required items are complete.
